testBased.trigger: Liquid with flash point < 60C (140F); non-liquid that can cause fire through friction/moisture/spontaneous reaction and burns vigorously/persistently; ignitable compressed gas; DOT oxidizer.
testBased.commonHazardClasses: Class 3 (Flammable liquid) most commonly; also Division 4.1, 2.1, 5.1 -- but only if the actual flash-point/burn test is met, not automatically.

testBased.trigger: Aqueous, pH <= 2 or >= 12.5; OR liquid that corrodes steel (SAE 1020) at >= 6.35 mm/year at 55C.
testBased.commonHazardClasses: Class 8 (Corrosive) most commonly -- but not every Class 8 material meets the specific pH/corrosion-rate test.

testBased.trigger: Normally unstable/reacts violently; reacts violently with water; forms explosive mixtures with water; generates toxic gas with water at pH 2-12.5; capable of detonation; DOT Class 1 explosive; cyanide/sulfide-bearing waste that releases toxic gas at low pH.
testBased.commonHazardClasses: Division 4.2, 4.3, 5.2, Class 1 -- again, characteristic-based, not automatic from class alone.

tclpMetals.notes: UN number varies by compound (e.g. UN1561 Arsenic trioxide).
UN1564 Barium compound, n.o.s. or specific barium salt entries.
UN3288 or specific chromium compound entries -- hexavalent vs. trivalent ship differently.
UN2291 Lead compound, soluble, n.o.s. or specific lead salt entries.
UN2809 Mercury (also U151 if unused product).
UN1493 Silver compound, oxidizing, n.o.s. or non-oxidizing entries.
